transcription.full_text: this is an insane thing about our economy. This graph shows average wealth for the bottom half of Americans. You can see that during the Great Recession, we dipped into negative wealth because most people were in debt. Right now, it stands about $800 per person on average. If we add in the next 40%, the next 40% of the rich Americans, well, we see a huge gap. On average, they have 450,000, while the bottom half has only $800 accounts. If we add in the next 10%, we can see that gap between the bottom and the next 40% looks minuscule in comparison to that next, where they have an average 5.5 million. If we add in the next 1%, suddenly that gap looks like nothing. And let's just jump to the top 0.01%, where 20,000 people owned on average, $900 million in wealth, making the rest of us look almost the same in comparison. Those are the $800 look almost the same to those with $5 million. And we know this all started around the 1980s when that gap started to expand massively. This is the same policy that Trump is trying to put in place right now.
